description: This file defines the CurlHandler class, which provides an HTTP request handler implementation using cURL in PHP. It manages cURL handles via a factory, processes requests, optionally delays execution, and executes cURL calls.

classes.name: CurlHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler that uses cURL easy handles as a transport layer, allowing sending HTTP requests with customizable cURL options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the CurlHandler with optional cURL handle factory configuration.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request, potentially delays execution, executes the cURL handle, and returns a promise.
